name: Reduce wasmoon wasm size without hurting features/startup/runtime/performance

description: Baseline: add autoresearch harness/checks and measure current wasm output size with startup/runtime guardrails
Try release LTO (-flto) on the emcc build; it significantly increased wasm size despite neutral startup/runtime
Switch the release emcc optimization profile from -O3 to -Oz; large wasm size reduction with startup improved and runtime roughly unchanged
Add NDEBUG and disable unwind table emission on top of -Oz; startup/runtime stayed fine but wasm size was unchanged

Try -fno-inline-functions with -Oz; saved ~0.5% wasm bytes but emitted unsupported-flag warnings and showed a likely heapsort slowdown, so not worth keeping under the no-performance-regression constraint
Try Emscripten's wasm longjmp support under -Oz; size regressed slightly and tests emitted Promise rejection warnings, so correctness/backpressure failed
Set ABORTING_MALLOC=0 with -Oz; wasm size was unchanged and the run showed worse secondary perf, so no reason to keep it
Force SUPPORT_LONGJMP=emscripten under -Oz; behavior stayed correct but wasm size was unchanged
Add -fno-inline-functions on top of -Oz; small extra wasm reduction with checks passing and startup/runtime remaining effectively flat in the current harness
Add -fno-unroll-loops on top of -Oz -fno-inline-functions; wasm grew slightly and representative runtime worsened
Try -fno-inline-functions-called-once on top of the current best; clang ignored the flag and wasm size stayed unchanged
Add -fvisibility=hidden on top of -Oz -fno-inline-functions; wasm size was unchanged
Disable vectorization passes on top of -Oz -fno-inline-functions; wasm size was unchanged
Try disabling errno support; Emscripten rejected SUPPORT_ERRNO in strict mode, so this path is invalid
Try forcing wasm import/export minification; Emscripten treats MINIFY_WASM_IMPORTS_AND_EXPORTS as internal-only, so this path is unavailable
Disable Emscripten auto JS/native library inclusion on top of the current best; build still worked but wasm size was unchanged
Force ASSERTIONS=0 on top of the current best; behavior stayed fine but wasm size was unchanged
Try -fmerge-all-constants on top of -Oz -fno-inline-functions; wasm size was unchanged
Sanity-check -Os versus the current -Oz best while keeping -fno-inline-functions; wasm grew substantially, so -Oz remains the right optimization family
Try an explicit post-link wasm-opt -Oz pass; the Binaryen tool required extra feature flags for the emitted module, so the naive pass pipeline is invalid
Add an explicit post-link Binaryen pass with wasm-opt --all-features -Oz on top of -Oz -fno-inline-functions; small further wasm reduction with checks passing
Add Binaryen strip passes (producers/target-features/toolchain annotations) after the kept wasm-opt -Oz pass; wasm size stayed unchanged and the run's secondary perf was worse
Add explicit Binaryen duplicate-function/merge-similar/vacuum passes after the kept wasm-opt -Oz step; wasm size stayed unchanged
Try LLVM merge-functions on top of the current best; wasm size stayed unchanged and the run's secondary runtime was worse
Try Binaryen GUFA plus signature pruning after the kept wasm-opt pass; signature-pruning requires closed-world mode, so this naive combination is invalid
